name: Spending Lunar Phase from a full pool restarts the 4 s regeneration timer; spending with stacks missing does not
contract: Lunar Phase regenerates one stack every 4 s from the passive driver 524781, which keeps ticking while the pool
is full and wastes those ticks. Consuming Lunar Eclipse right before such a tick handed a stack back at once.
Expected: with a full pool of 8 (Bright Moon), consuming an Eclipse leaves 4 and the next stack arrives a full
4 s later, not at the next stale tick. With stacks already missing (5 after that regeneration), consuming an
Eclipse keeps the running timer, so the next stack still arrives on the original schedule.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Bright Moon raises the Lunar Phase cap to eight
Moonwell Splash consumes the Eclipse
Seven stacks, so the next regeneration tick fills the pool
SYNC: the pool fills to eight on a regeneration tick
Let most of the 4 s interval pass so the next stale tick is about 1 s away
Activate Lunar Eclipse from a full pool
Eclipse is active
Moonwell Splash consumes the Eclipse
Eclipse is consumed
Four of the eight stacks were spent
DISCRIMINATING: no stack came back at the stale tick
Let most of the 4 s interval pass
Stacks stay at four before the 4 s mark
A full 4 s after the spend, the first stack arrives
Let part of the interval pass with stacks missing
Activate Lunar Eclipse with five stacks
Eclipse is active
Moonwell Splash consumes the Eclipse
Eclipse is consumed
DISCRIMINATING: the running timer was kept, so the next stack arrives on the original schedule
